integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained; the bundled finite-section computation is supplementary and does not certify an infinite-dimensional statement. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted harmonic Bergman space and quadratic analytic symbols only; the isolated eigenprojection exists only when 7/4<|b|<7/3. The full Wang–Zhao 2021 quadratic example was not available for priority verification.
title: Sharp asymmetric Riesz-projection blow-up for a quadratic harmonic-Bergman Toeplitz outlier
